sections.heading: MINOR IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - English and Writing Studies
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from English 1020-1999 with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course in a Survey of Literary Traditions from: English 2301E, English 2401E, English 2501E, English 2601E.
0.5 course in Theory from: English 2200-2260, English 3200-3210, Theatre Studies 3205F/G, Film Studies 3371F/G, or Writing 2215F/G.
1.0 course in Pre-1800 Literature from: English 3290-3349, English 3440-3449, English 3540-3549, English 3640-3649, (but not English 3333E (Huron)).
1.0 course in Post-1800 Literature from: English 3350-3399, English 3450-3499, English 3550-3599, English 3650-3699, English 3700-3799, English 3850-3899.
Note: This module facilitates switching at a later date to a Major or Honours Specialization in English.
